overall: The AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by convening in executive session on a complaint without proper notice, Purpose 1 rights, or procedural requirements, and by failing to create minutes.

allegations.summary: Commission discussed a complaint against a Recreation Department employee in executive session without listing the topic on the June 11 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because the anticipated topic was not added to the June 11 notice, the Commission should not have discussed the topic at that meeting.

allegations.summary: Commission convened in executive session on a personnel complaint without giving the subject employee 48 hours written notice or advising her of her Purpose 1 rights.
allegations.key_passage: Here, although Ms. Campbell was present, the Commission did not provide her with 48 hours written notice of the meeting or advise her of her rights during that session.

allegations.summary: Commission did not properly describe the executive session purpose, did not announce whether it would reconvene, and did not take the convening vote by roll call.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Commission did not sufficiently describe the purpose for the executive session prior to convening; it did not announce whether it would reconvene in open session; and it did not take its vote to convene in executive session by roll call.

allegations.summary: Commission failed to create minutes of the June 11 executive session; the AG found this violation although the complaint did not raise it.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create minutes of its June 11 executive session.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
Create minutes from the June 11 executive session within 30 days and, once created, publicly release the minutes and any documents used, subject to applicable exemptions.
Provide the complainant with an un-redacted copy of the executive session minutes within 5 days of their approval.
Review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Training Videos #4 (Executive Sessions) and #5 (Meeting Minutes and Records) and certify compliance within 30 days.
remedy_passage: we order the Commission to create and approve minutes of its June 11 executive session within 30 days of receipt of this decision
